title: Edit several places at once
text: Hold Alt and click in the editor to add cursors. Edits are applied at every cursor.

title: Add cursors to selected lines
text: Select several lines and press Alt+Shift+I to place a cursor at the end of each line.

title: Bookmark a line
text: Press Ctrl+M to toggle a bookmark on the current line. Use Ctrl+, and Ctrl+. to move between bookmarks.

title: Find a bookmark with the Locator
text: Open the Locator with Ctrl+K, enter b and a space, then type a line number or text to filter bookmarks.

title: Customize keyboard shortcuts
text: Search for a command in Preferences > Environment > Keyboard to find or change its shortcut.

title: Follow a symbol into another split
text: Press Ctrl+E, then F2 to open the symbol definition in the next editor split.

title: Compare files side by side
text: Press Ctrl+E, then 3 to split the editor side by side. Press Ctrl+E, then O to move between splits.

title: Open a C++ header or source file
text: With a C++ file open, press F4 to switch between its header and source file.

title: Stage only part of a change
text: In the Git Diff view, stage individual chunks or lines instead of the whole file.

title: Review the history of a selection
text: Use Git > Current File > Log of File Selection to see commits that changed the selected text.

title: See who last changed a line
text: Move the cursor through a file and hover over the instant blame annotation to see commit details. Enable it in Preferences > Version Control > Git if needed.

title: Set aside unstaged Git changes
text: Use Git > Local Repository > Stash > Stash Unstaged Files to save unstaged work while keeping staged changes.

title: Create a C++ class from a template
text: Choose File > New File > C/C++ > C++ Class to create a header and source file together.

title: Look up any command shortcut
text: The Keyboard preferences list shortcuts for menu commands and buttons. Filter by the command name to find one quickly.

title: Choose tabs or spaces for indentation
text: Set the tab size and whether Tab inserts spaces or tabs in Preferences > Text Editor > Behavior.

title: Show line numbers and whitespace
text: In Preferences > Text Editor > Display, enable line numbers and whitespace visualization to inspect indentation.
